candidates.name: Minab-Sirik-Kuhmobarak Gas Pipeline
aka: Sea of Oman Coast Gas Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC engineering subsidiary)

evidence.note: 200 km NIGC transmission line in two sections: 120 km Minab-Sirik (~87% complete) plus Sirik-Kuhmobarak (construction began Feb 2023). Connects to IGAT-7 national grid; gas sourced from South Pars. Aims to supply SE domestic customers and demonstrate capacity to export to Oman.

Independent confirmation: 200 km pipeline from Minab to Kuhmobarak on the Sea of Oman; first 120 km Minab-Sirik segment ~87% complete, second section (Sirik-Kuhmobarak) started February. Tied into IGAT-7, South Pars supply, framed as enabling Oman exports.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row covers a Minab / Sirik / Kuhmobarak coastal trunkline. Distinct from P2225 Iran-Oman Gas Pipeline (Rudan County->Sohar port, the subsea export leg to Oman) and from P0446 IGAT 7 (Asaluyeh->Iranshahr) which this line feeds off. This is an onshore coastal transmission branch down the Sea of Oman shore; not represented under any existing name/endpoint. Borderline overlap only with P2225 (both invoke Oman export) but different route/endpoints, so emitting for consolidator to judge.
